ITEM-1.catatan: Photo shows a mounted fire extinguisher, seat belt and buckle, exterior mirrors and steering wheel, with dust and surface wear. Gauge reading and expiry details are not legible in the photo. Kandar directly reports cabin normal, seat belt locks, mirrors intact, horn sounds, extinguisher seal intact, gauge green and extinguisher not expired. Functional checks and gauge/expiry assessment are based on the inspector's account, not the photo.

ITEM-2.catatan: Photo documents the dashboard with two round gauges and an illuminated orange/red indicator; gauge labels, exact readings and indicator function are not reliably identifiable. Dust and surface wear are visible. Kandar reports stationary tests per SOP: air pressure within normal operating range, low-air warning off, no leaks, parking brake holds and service brake response normal. Pressure, warning status, leakage and brake performance are based on the inspector's direct checks, not established by the photo.

ITEM-3.catatan: Photo shows two wheels on one side with visible tread, sidewalls and wheel nuts with yellow markers; dirt and surface rust are present. No clear bulge, exposed cord or major cut is visible in the pictured areas. Kandar reports checking all tyres and wheel nuts on both sides: normal, no bulges or major cuts, all nuts present and not loose. Coverage of all tyres and nut tightness is based on the inspector's direct checks, not established by the photo.

ITEM-4.catatan: Photo shows the dump body floor, inner sidewalls and front wall with surface rust, dirt and scrape marks; no clear structural crack is visible in the pictured areas. Shadow limits front detail, and weld integrity and mounting tightness cannot be established from this view. Kandar reports directly checking the floor, welds and mountings from a safe position: no cracks, deformation or looseness, only surface rust and dirt. Full structural condition and mounting security are based on the inspector's checks, not established by the photo alone.

ITEM-5.catatan: Photo shows an extended hydraulic cylinder, two hoses, couplings and base mounting beneath the raised body; no clear fluid drip, pooling or hose rupture is visible. Surrounding metalwork has dirt and surface rust. Kandar reports directly checking the cylinder, hoses, connections and seals: dry, without leaks or damage, from a safe side with isolation and mechanical prop engaged. Complete seal and hose condition, isolation and prop engagement are based on the inspector's account, not confirmed by this view.

ITEM-6.catatan: Photo shows a straight-appearing mechanical safety prop between the chassis and raised body, upper contact plate, bolted lower mounting and transverse pin with retaining clip. No clear break or deformation is visible; dirt, worn paint and surface rust are present. Kandar reports the prop is normal and straight, seated at both supports with the pin locked, checked from the side under safe isolation without entering beneath the body. Full seating, locking security and isolation are based on the inspector's direct account, not established by the photo alone.

ITEM-7.catatan: Photo shows one tailgate corner with a horizontal latch arm, pivot bolt and hanging retaining loop; dirt, worn paint and surface rust are visible, with no clear break in the pictured latch. The opposite latch is outside the view, and hinge/pin integrity and secure closure cannot be established from the photo alone. Kandar reports hinges and pins intact and a completed closure test: tailgate closes tightly and both latches lock properly, with only surface rust. Functional closure and both latch checks are based on the inspector's direct account.

ITEM-8.catatan: Photo shows illuminated red and amber lamps in both rear clusters, white lamps at the upper rear corners and visible side, and reflective strips around the tailgate, side and rear bar. Dirt, worn paint and surface rust are visible. A single photo does not establish brake-light response, indicator flashing, headlight operation or all reflector condition. Kandar reports testing headlights, both brake lights and all indicators with a colleague from safe positions: all normal, reflectors intact. Functional results and full reflector condition are based on the inspector's direct checks, not established by the photo alone.
